valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027E EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Precious metals pullback and slower stream ramp

base.driver: Steady 860k-940k GEO production and sustained gold/silver prices

bull.driver: Higher realized metal prices and accelerated Antamina/Salobo stream volumes

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $4.80, the $131.45 close implies 27.4x forward P/E; at 28x P/E, the ~$160-$172 Street consensus target implies $5.71-$6.14 EPS.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $4.80 (3.7 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Attributable Gold Equivalent Ounces (GEO) production vs. 2026 guidance of 860,000-940,000 GEOs and realized gold/silver prices

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 results on Nov 5, 2026 ($0.90 adjusted EPS, $771.7M revenue, $645M operating cash flow), UBS trimmed its target from $160 to $155 while Scotiabank maintained $175, both keeping Buy/Outperform ratings. Named targets cluster between $145 and $175 (+10% to +33% above the $131.45 close), above our $134.40 base case (+2.2%) because Street models price higher realized metal prices or richer streaming multiples. Target horizons are set to null where 12-month horizons were not explicitly documented in accessible summaries.
